ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the above diagram, which organism is known as producer?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a food web. On the left side it is labeled "Plant". Arrows point from Plant to aphid, caterpillar, and whitefly; aphid points to ladybird, caterpillar points to bird, whitefly points to spider, and ladybird and spider also have arrow relationships with bird. Reasoning: A producer is an organism that can make its own food and is usually located at the base position of a food chain or food web. The one in the figure that fits this role is Plant.
